title: SourcesItemRemovedPayload
description: sources.item.removed v1 (OpenVibe.Sources server/items.js remove → itemEvent, from DELETE /api/v1/items/:id). Staff removed an item (takedown, licence, error). Sticky: a later fetch that still lists it does not bring it back. The removal bumps the revision; content_hash is the last content's. Envelope: subject { type: item, id: <item_id>, revision }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:sources.

kind.description: article | url | sitemap | product | offer | review | record … (sources.item@1 kind).

retrieved_at.description: Last successful fetch (or manual entry) that contained the item.
